summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: new Update container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py (prologue, algebra); translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update container, with the empty-request path building the prologue from the single declaration group via translatePrologue; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py beside prepareQuery; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covering the required behaviors. The string path, processUpdate, and the processor's update method are unchanged apart from passing the container through. Not run: tests were not executed and black was not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. The test for initBindings in an INSERT/WHERE template is the most likely to need adjustment once run.
